From: Anna Reed <anna.recruiter@northbridge.edu>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spring interns — conversion packet and evaluations

Hi Mina,

Attached is the packet for the spring cohort you interviewed last month. We highlighted the three students who expressed strong interest in full-time offers and provided scorecards from each interview panel: Samir Kaur, Rachel Li, and Miguel Torres.

Quick notes:
- Samir has a strong backend profile and excellent system design feedback.
- Rachel is more product-adjacent but showed strong ownership and a fast learning curve.
- Miguel needs a little ramp on infra but got high marks on collaboration.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will move forward with conversions and the timeline for extending offers? We typically ask companies to confirm headcount and bands by end of next week so students can plan.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Anna Reed
Senior Employer Relations
Northbridge Career Center

Team — forwarding Anna's packet. TL;DR: three strong conversion candidates from Northbridge. Recruiting asks for headcount confirmation + comp bands by next week.

I recommend we convert all three headcount slots (IC/entry-level SWE) for the May start. Proposed (manager-level) guidance:
- Samir Kaur — band A2 (competitive backend mix)
- Rachel Li — band A1 (entry-level product-adjacent)
- Miguel Torres — band A1 with performance review at 6 months

Open questions:
1) Markus: any flexibility to stretch Samir up to +$2k above A2 base? he had a couple competing offers.
2) Dev: can you prep offers using our standard intern-conversion package + sign-off checklist (attach template)?
3) Laura/Tessa: any objections to headcount here given Q2 hiring plan?

I'll schedule a brief 15-minute slot if that helps.

Thanks — Mina
Head of University Recruiting (interim)
Redwood Inference

Thanks for pulling this together, Mina. I support converting all three slots into full-time headcount. A couple of operational notes:

- Headcount: approve 3 FTE conversions under the University Hiring budget for May start.
- Comp bands: use A1 for Rachel and Miguel; Samir at A2 is fine but please escalate any request above the published band to me for sign-off.
- Timing: offers should go out by 03/18 to respect student timelines.

Dev — please prepare the offer letters and include the standard 1-year relocation allowance language where applicable. Markus — if you think Samir needs to be above A2, flag the specific comp number so we can evaluate budget impact.
